## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy src` passes
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] New tools have tests and a docstring with `Args:`/`Returns:` sections
- [ ] `docs/TOOLS.md` updated if a tool was added, renamed, or changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
